blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Presiding Officer Francis Escudero says on Day 44 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial that defense witness Rowena Mendoza, Department Manager III of the Center for International Expositions and Missions (Citem), has acknowledged receiving the subpoena issued by the Senate impeachment court but is currently in Germany. Mendoza has requested additional time to submit the required documents and asked that her appearance before the court be rescheduled to a later date./dp LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 19, 2026... Keep on reading: WATCH: Defense witness in Germany seeks postponement of testimony
